The '''HCT-2001 ''Dragonboat''-class Reugeot 905 freighter''' was used by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] hunters during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
The slave ship had two braking thrusters facing forward, to aid in landing procedures.<ref name="EGPL">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode321.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Padawan Lost}}</ref> At least 12 cargo modules were located towards the stern of the ship and it was armed with a laser turret.<ref name="PL" />

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], thanks to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]], were able to finance a [[Trandoshan fleet|fleet]], the main unit of which was the HCT-2001 Dragonboat. Many [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] were used during the [[attack on Kashyyyk]] and in the [[Rebellion on Felucia|defense]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|fleet]].<ref name="Kinect" />

A Trandoshan slave ship, the ''[[Vermin-Thrax/Legends|Vermin-Thrax]]'', was used to carry captives to the isolated jungle moon of [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]]. They abducted various aliens, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]], and [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiates]] (such as [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Jinx/Legends|Jinx]], [[Kalifa/Legends|Kalifa]], and [[O-Mer/Legends|O-Mer]]) and held them in cages on this ship. After the captives were brought to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of Wasskah and released into jungle, the hunt began.<ref name="PL" />
